original_findings.title: Native C03 accepts a contract-case-input envelope larger than the explicit 8192-byte producer limit

steps: Obtain the real producer positive with capture_graph() and stage_payload(); native validate_stage accepts it unchanged.

Deep-copy the generated stage, replace case-input.input.payload.value.capture with 3800 TAB characters, and independently reseal context/input/BoundProcedure/Brief/composition/manifest using the existing relink helper. No limit, schema or native validator is patched.
Compare API validate_material/produce_input and the native public validate_stage on those fully correlated bytes.

original_findings.violated_criterion: Delegated C03 contract: input envelope <=8192 bytes and native independent same-bytes rejection before cold child construction. API producer and API material validator enforce this cap, but native only checks capture bytes (4096), value bytes (8192), and the generic envelope/frame cap (32768).
original_findings.impact: The independent native pre-constructor validator admits an input record that the actual backend producer forbids. Fully resealed API-origin frame is 32307 bytes, so the separate 32768-byte frame cap does not compensate. This is a contract/defense-in-depth defect, not evidence of a working model/target or an unauthenticated external exploit.
original_findings.minimal_fix: In _capture_material explicitly reject len(canonical(input_record)) > 8192 before returning. Add the 3800-TAB envelope-overflow negative and a below-cap positive through validate_stage, including a generated API-origin composition. Update composer SHA/pin and requalify/rebuild only as required by the changed artifact closure.
original_findings.proof_boundary: Real source producer and real native adapter validators; native installed AIAgent construction was not run. Static pinned patch shows validate_stage is the pre-constructor guard at dispatch and SubagentLifecycleService.stage.

original_nonblocking.title: Native accepts a noncanonical base64 spelling rejected by the API
original_nonblocking.reproducer: Use the API-origin schema source_b64 (two padding characters); flip the least significant pad bit of the final non-padding base64 character. Decoding produces identical schema bytes. Reseal via relink and compare native validate_stage with API validate_material.
original_nonblocking.criterion: Producer/native accepted-language parity with the explicit base64 round-trip check in contract_case_input.py:225-228.
original_nonblocking.limit: Not counted as a release blocker independently: original decoded schema bytes, digest and size are unchanged. It is not schema substitution or a demonstrated authority escalation.
original_nonblocking.minimal_fix: Mirror base64.b64encode(raw).decode("ascii") == source_b64 in native validation, or explicitly document why the native language intentionally permits aliases.

dispositions.implementation: Reject canonical input_record envelope sizes above 8192 immediately after envelope validation, before payload/body handling. Existing capture/value/schema/frame caps are unchanged.
same_channel_evidence: Original API-origin fully resealed 3800-TAB case: input 8399 bytes, frame 32307; native now refuses ValueError / Invalid prompt composition. Actual API producer, material validator and composition validator refuse CASE_INPUT_LIMIT.
Actual producer 3600-TAB positive: input 7999, frame 31732; producer, API material, API composition and native all accept.
Independent exact boundary: 8192-byte record is accepted by all four checks; 8193-byte record is rejected by all four, with frame sizes 31996 and 31998 respectively.
Original synthetic native-fixture overflow also now refuses; unchanged ordinary positive, NUL and Unicode overflow controls retain their expected outcomes.
dispositions.red_evidence: Original snapshot defect established in original report. Parent reports corrected DID NOT RAISE RED after an initial mapping-copy oracle failure; this review did not rerun historical bytes or overwrite that history.
dispositions.closure_limit: Source validate_stage boundary exercised, not installed AIAgent constructor or deployed image.

dispositions.implementation: Require strict decoded schema bytes to re-encode to the exact source_b64 spelling; no normalization or silent substitution.
same_channel_evidence: Original API-origin padded schema: altered final non-padding character pad bit, confirmed different spelling but identical decoded bytes, independently resealed the entire existing stage.
Native rejects Invalid prompt composition; API material and composition reject INVALID_CASE_INPUT_SCHEMA. Canonical original is accepted on the same generated API-origin channel.
Every independent matrix case preserves canonical stage bytes before/after validation.
dispositions.closure_limit: This re-review closes the specific accepted-language mismatch; no schema substitution or authority exploit was claimed originally or now.
